plain_english_summary: A player carelessly trips or attempts to trip an opponent while challenging for the ball.
criteria_checklist: Defender makes leg or foot contact with the opponent
Contact causes or contributes to the opponent falling or losing balance
Challenge is careless rather than cleanly playing the ball
official_rule_reference: IFAB/FIFA Law 12 - Fouls and Misconduct; Direct Free Kick

plain_english_summary: A player challenges with disregard for an opponent's safety or the consequences of the challenge.
criteria_checklist: Challenge is late, forceful, or uncontrolled
Player makes significant contact with the opponent
Challenge shows disregard for opponent safety
official_rule_reference: IFAB/FIFA Law 12 - Fouls and Misconduct; Caution for Reckless Play

plain_english_summary: A player uses excessive force or endangers an opponent while challenging for the ball.
criteria_checklist: Challenge uses high force or speed
Studs, locked leg, or high contact point endangers opponent
Contact is above normal playing force
official_rule_reference: IFAB/FIFA Law 12 - Sending-off Offenses; Serious Foul Play

plain_english_summary: A player illegally handles the ball with the hand or arm, especially when deliberate or making the body unnaturally bigger.
criteria_checklist: Ball contacts player's hand or arm
Arm position is deliberate or makes the body unnaturally bigger
Player gains possession, scores, or blocks a meaningful attacking action

plain_english_summary: A player pushes an opponent in a careless, reckless, or excessive-force manner.
criteria_checklist: Player extends arm, shoulder, or body into opponent
Contact moves, unbalances, or prevents the opponent from playing the ball
Contact is not a fair shoulder-to-shoulder challenge
official_rule_reference: IFAB/FIFA Law 12 - Direct Free Kick Offenses; Pushes an Opponent

plain_english_summary: A player in an offside position becomes involved in active play when the ball is played by a teammate.
criteria_checklist: Attacker is nearer to the opponents' goal line than both the ball and second-last opponent
Position is judged when a teammate plays or touches the ball
Attacker interferes with play, interferes with an opponent, or gains an advantage
